summary: Vivakor filed an 8-K on Sept 30, 2026 disclosing that EVP/COO Leslie D. Patterson resigned effective Sept 24, 2026, under a Mutual Transition Agreement dated Sept 17, 2026. Vivakor will pay all wages through the Transition Date plus $150,000 within 24 hours of Sept 24, as full satisfaction of wages, bonus, severance and benefit claims. The parties must execute a consulting agreement by Oct 9, 2026, with Patterson paid in registered common stock under the S-8 plan. No disagreement was disclosed. Watch for the consulting agreement terms, equity issuance dilution, and whether Patterson files a response letter.
